name: Making Mascot Love <3
source:
Fall in love with the mascot of your dreams.

Play as a college freshman experiencing the highs and lows, the triumphs and defeats, of college love in this exciting new dating sim. Love interests heavily inspired by certain college mascots with one exciting sports team appearance!

[From [url=https://promphyrus.itch.io/makingmonsterlove]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
爱上你梦想中的吉祥物。

在这款令人兴奋的全新约会模拟游戏中，扮演一名大学新生，体验大学爱情的高潮和低谷、胜利和失败。恋爱兴趣很大程度上受到某些大学吉祥物的启发，其中有一支令人兴奋的运动队亮相！

[来自[url=https://promphyrus.itch.io/makingmonsterlove]Itch.io[/url]]
